Game folder:
%1$s

%2$s

Copy the original PC release assets into this folder, preserving their directory structure. For app-specific storage, place them inside Android/data/com.c4rlox.simpsons/files, not directly inside Android/data.

If you have any questions about installation, visit the GitHub documentation, where everything is explained in detail:
https://github.com/Carlox33/The-Simpsons-Hit-and-Run-Android/blob/master/INSTALLATION.md

After copying the files into your chosen folder, close and reopen the app.

Choose where to place the original PC game files:

You have 2 options:

WITHOUT storage permission: use the app-specific folder Android/data/com.c4rlox.simpsons/files. Place the game files directly inside files, preserving their directory structure. The app can read this folder without broad storage access.

WITH storage permission: use the shared folder:
%1$s
It is at the root of shared storage, alongside Download and DCIM. It is created once permission is available.

%3$s
